name: Prefect (self-hosted)
sku: Prefect OSS server, self-hosted, Apache 2.0. Prefect Cloud is a separate managed deployment of the same engine and is not scored.

orchestrate.dependency-dag.note: Flows are plain Python functions that branch, loop and create tasks at runtime rather than a DAG declared up front, so dependencies come from ordinary function calls, not a separate graph definition.

orchestrate.scheduling.note: Deployments run a flow on a schedule, alongside on-demand and event-driven runs.

orchestrate.event-triggers.note: Automations are first-class in self-hosted Server as well as Cloud in Prefect 3.x: triggers fire from flow-run state changes, metric thresholds or custom events. Webhook-based triggers need inbound routing configured, and production use needs PostgreSQL rather than the default SQLite to avoid lock contention delaying them.

bands.note: The UI tracks flow and task run states, logs and automatic retries. It covers run health, not the data's own quality.

presentation.tagline: Python-native orchestration: flows are ordinary functions, not a DAG declared up front.

cost.note: No licence cost (Apache 2.0; Prefect Cloud is the separate paid product, not scored here). `hosting` is generic cloud compute pricing sized against a comparable VM at each volume: the default SQLite is fine at light use, but production needs PostgreSQL to avoid lock contention (from the 1TB point up), plus more instance capacity for concurrent flows at higher volume — not a Prefect-specific figure.
